name: Armory
overview: The Bible depicts the armory as both a physical location for storing armor, as seen in Nehemiah's description of repairs near the armoury (Nehemiah 3:19) and Isaiah's reference to the armour of the house of the forest (Isaiah 22:8), and as a symbol of divine power and judgment, illustrated by Jeremiah's portrayal of the LORD opening His armoury to unleash His weapons of indignation (Jeremiah 50:25). Additionally, the armory is associated with valuable treasures and instruments of protection within a kingdom, exemplified by Hezekiah showing his house of armour along with precious items (Isaiah 39:2). Thus, Scripture presents the armory both in its literal function within the kingdom and figuratively as a representation of God's sovereign defense and judgment.
